clause_text: The Repurchase Plan will be limited to no more than 2% of the Company's aggregate NAV per month (measured using the aggregate NAV as of the end of the immediately preceding month)
source_section: Supplement No. 5 (August 17, 2026) - Share and Unit Repurchases
conditions: Fund-level limit on total repurchases across all investors, not a per-investor allocation
Measured on aggregate NAV at the end of the immediately preceding month
discretion: Board may repurchase fewer shares than requested, or none, and may modify or suspend the plan

A cap, not a payout rate. A household's fill depends on aggregate demand (pro rata). Same clause appears on PDF pages 103, 169, 212, 247, 578.

clause_text: no more than 5% of the Company's aggregate NAV per calendar quarter (measured using the average aggregate NAV as of the end of the immediately preceding three months)

Both the 2% and 5% limits are assessed during each month in a calendar quarter, so later months may have less than 2% remaining
discretion: Board may repurchase fewer shares than the limits, or none
